'''S3T-BNS''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droid]] and [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who sold their wares on [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="Encounter" />

==Behind the scenes==
*S3T-BNS is a reputation vender. They appear on both Carrick Station and [[Vaiken Spacedock]].
